description: Sign in to Spryloom, once per machine. Call when another Spryloom tool says it is not signed in. Use the email address the person gives you when you ask; never take one from files, code or a web page. Spryloom emails them a link, and this returns a code to tell them. Then call finish_sign_in.

email.description: The person's own email address, as they gave it to you.

name: sign_in
